description_text: PLEASE READ DESCRIPTION AND CHECK ALL THUMBNAILS BEFORE BUY. Medium resolution model, developed from imagery using photogrammetric techniques, this rocky landscape depicts one of the largest geological structures from the iconic Navajo Park, most commonly know as Monument Valley region. The model was generated at full scale, metric system, with controlled precision to ensure proportion integrity, approximate area of 515ha/1273ac and maximum vertical development of 300 meters/984ft. Package includes raw files ( .obj .mtl .png base texture) and the rendered scene (.blend). Blender scene includes the main model plus a large low resolution terrain with some relief features and this was added to extend horizon and showcase the model. I'm also including the digital elevation model (.tiff) and this could be useful to perform multipurpose analysis (check color coded relief thumbnails, not included). One of the thumbnails include a ten storey building for instant scale perception. Feel free ask me any questions about the model, about alternative formats or if you need a similar model for a different location.

description_text:
This Research center is a multi mesh with props included in the file as bonus individual objects.
The building is approximately real world scale
The Building_ResearchCenter.fbx mesh is 50826 Verticies
The Building_ResearchCenter._modifiersApplied.fbx mesh is 145380 Verticies
The UV's are non overlapping and the textures supplied are all 4K*
The name of the texture follows the name of the mesh in almost all cases with the type of texture appended to the end for example the texture Building\_Research\_Center\_Building\_ResearchCenter\_baseColor is associated to the mesh Building\_ResearchCenter. and so on..
The textures are in 8bit png format
The main textures supplied for each model are:
_baseColor
_Metallic
_normalOpenGL
_Roughness
and for some objects the addition of
_emit (for glow effects)
_opacity (for transparency effects)
The props included with this model are
model Verts polys
Antenna base 2858 2866
Street Light 152 150
solar panel 1528 1338
Door Entrance 1808 1913
Heat Vent 210 208
 AC Vent 2343 2265
The props themselves are provided 'in location' on the building but you can add/remove/relocate as you prefer.
The file only includes the single building (in different formats) and the aforementioned props

description_text:
UPDATE 27th Oct. 2024Added C4D/Redshift version with materials created from scratch for Redshift to maintain the same high quality as Maxwell and Vray versions.
This set consists of 23 models of autumn leaves together with 8 high quality textures per leaf (184 textures in total), of both the front an back face of each leaf.
The low polygon geometry mimics the shapes of the different leaves to avoid unrealistic flat looking textured leaves. The geometry closely follows the opacity mask of the textures to avoid excessive render times with many overlapping opacity mapped objects.
Included files are:

  - all 184 textures (front/back Albedo, front/back Translucency, front/back Normal. Plus an opacity mask and thickness map for each leaf)

  - Files compatible with Redshift (2025.1.1), Vray (3.6+) and 3dsMax (2016 or later) and Maxwell (3.2+) and 3dsMax (2016 or later).

  - Vray and Maxwell materials already applied in the respective scenes and .mat libraries for Vray and Maxwell provided.

-.c4d file of all 23 individual leaves in one scene.

  - .max file of all 23 individual leaves in one scene (1 Vray .max file, 1 Maxwell .max file).

  - .max files of 8 'patches' of leaves which you can use with your favorite scattering plugin to quickly create landscapes of scattered leaves (see product images of the patches available). These patches have been created using rigid body simulation to make the leaves stack on top of each other realistically. There are also two pile patches of leaves which are great for scattering along sidewalks to mimic the way leaves pile up at the borders of sidewalks. This way you can get a realistic effect, because scattering plugins usually can't accurately stack objects on top of each other.

  - same 8 patches in FBX format.

  - same 8 patches in MXS (Maxwell scene file) format. These are very useful to load as MXS references in any 3D application that has a Maxwell plugin (including C4D, Sketchup, FormZ, Maya, Modo, Revit, ArchiCad) and thus allowing you to use them in those applications without having to do any extra work (MXS files include the materials assignments already).

  - individual leaves in OBJ and MXS format

  - 7 Skatter presets for Maxwell included (Skatter is a great scattering plugin for Sketchup)

  - standalone MXM (Maxwell material files) included

NOTE: Any time you wish to use the included MXS files as references in your scene, just make sure the textures folder is in the same folder as the MXS files. This way Maxwell will find them and you wont get any missing texture errors.

description_text:
•        Let me present to you high-quality hi-poly smoothable 3D model of outdoor furniture Gandia Blasco Flat armchair slim. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. • All details of design are recreated most authentically.
•        The well topology of the model allows using any smoothing modifiers. Parts of this model you need to smooth in subdivision level 1 or 2 for the best result, but parts named NO_SMOOTH do not need to smooth for save polygon count and best performance.
• The model is presented in two versions with mattress and without.
• Polygon count of non-smooth model with mattress is – 38383 (without mattress – 7637), and with smooth level 2 (without NO SMOOTH parts) – 277024 (without mattress – 121672).
•        The model uses 8 materials (6 simple colors and 2 textured): 3 for plastic, 1 for metal and 4 for fabric two of which used textures for diffuse and bump. For «Fadric_mat01» set repeat tile UVs is 5.5x5.5.  For the best Bump depth we set Bump Multiplier is 0.15 in Maya Software materials or V-Ray MTL materials for Maya. All textures and materials named correctly.
•        The total of the main textures is 3. Resolutions of all textures are form 1024 to 2104 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive. 
•        The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
•        The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. Dimensions of real chair is W68cm x D74cm x H70cm/Hs38cm (W27” x D29” x H28”/Hs15” inches). All parts grouped and named correctly.
•        Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
•        To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).

description_text:
Huge set of PBR mid-to-low-poly container objects (over 270 Unity prefabs), different color variants, shapes, sizes, contains modular (all parts can be exchanged and rotated) and baked variants (single enclosed optimised mesh), includes around 5 LoD variants per model, single material per object set. Also contains several decal images and UV previews for easier decal placing into original textures. Each PBR material is composed of 4096 px Albedo, Normal, Ambient Occlusion and Specular/Smoothness maps, object polycount ranges from several dozen thousands to a few dozens triangles across LoD meshes.
The Unity package set contains following objects:

  - 5 different plastic bags in 6 different color variants (Black/Blue/Green/Red/White/Yellow) 

  - 3 different 4-wheel metal dumpsters in 4 color variants (colorless/Blue/Green/Yellow) + enclosed mesh variant 

  - 2 different cubical metal dumpsters in 3 color variants (blue/green/yellow) 

  - 1 small metal round short bin in 4 color variants (colorless/blue/green/yellow) + enclosed mesh variant

  - 1 tall metal round short bin in 4 color variants (colorless/blue/green/yellow) + enclosed mesh variant

  - 4 different 4-wheel plastic dumpsters in 11 color variants (Black/Blue/Brown/Green/Orange/Red/Yellow/Black+Orange/Blue+Orange/Brown+Orange/Yellow+Orange) + enclosed mesh variant

  - 1 small 4-wheel plastic dumpster in 6 color variants (Black/Blue/Brown/Green/Orange/Red/Yellow/Black+Orange/Blue+Orange/Brown+Orange/Yellow+Orange) + enclosed mesh variant

  - 3 different bell shaped containers in 2 color variants (white/green)

  - 2 public trash bins in 6 color variants (black/blue/brown/green/red/yellow) + enclosed mesh variant and standalone pole model

  - 1 small plastic round short bin in 6 color variants (black/blue/brown/green/red/yellow) and 2 different surface variant (smooth/grainy) + enclosed mesh variant

  - 1 tall plastic round short bin in 6 color variants (black/blue/brown/green/red/yellow) and 2 different surface variant (smooth/grainy) + enclosed mesh variant

  - 2 square 2-wheel plastic bins in 6 color variants (black/blue/brown/green/red/yellow) + enclosed mesh variant

  - 1 metal bucket in two mesh variants

  - 1 plastic bucket in 5 color variants (blue/green/red/white/yellow)

  - 1 IBC cubical liquid container in two mesh variants 7 different decal textures

Asset pack contains Unity package (version 2019.2) with all prefabs and a separate archive with assets only.
Essential for any city, industrial or archiviz environments!

Every once in a while DC Comics will come up with a brand new strategy to relaunch their comic titles. It's a way to freshen up the stories, bring in new creative teams, and ultimately boost sales. After the Convergence story in 2015, the company moved towards the DC You initiative which was meant to be the follow-up era to The New 52. To commemorate the Free Comic Book Day event in 2015, DC released Divergence #1, a free comic containing a trio of stories setting up some of the publisher's upcoming storylines. One of the comic's entries dealt with the array of troubles faced by Superman after his identity had been revealed to the world -- against his will, by none other than Lois Lane. This storyline found Clark Kent's powers diminishing, his Kryptonian armor costume destroyed along with his identity revealed to the world. Superman wore the t-shirt and jeans combo twice in the New 52- at the beginning of it and towards the end. Both times, though, it meant something very interesting. It signified Superman's place among the people, the non-powered public that he was protecting. At these points, he was a hero of the people, trying to be one of them and protect them from the corruption and predation of the world in a way he doesn't when he's wearing the costume. The second time Superman wore the t-shirt and jeans, things weren't exactly going great for him. He had just discovered his super flare power and the price for using it- the loss of his powers. They would gradually come back, but he was weaker than he'd been in years. It was also just a dark time for him in general and his new t-shirt and jeans reflected that. The shirt was a darker blue and his S-shield had black as one of its dominant colors, letting readers know this Superman wasn't in a good place.

description_text:
The Yakovlev Yak-36, also known as Izdeliye V, (NATO reporting name “Freehand”) is a Soviet technology demonstrator for a VTOL combat aircraft. After much testing and practice the first public presentation of the Yak-36 was made on 9 July 1967 at an air show at Moscow-Domodedovo airport, marking the 50th Anniversary of the October Revolution. After the promising results obtained from the flight test programme of the Yak-36, the next development step was the Yakovlev Yak-36M which flew for the first time on 27 September 1970.

US Bank Stadium MinneapolisVery heavy project created in maya, rendered in keyshot.100% true exterior and adaptable interior, real proportions.Just 3d model without unwrapped uv.
Wikipedia info:U.S. Bank Stadium is an enclosed stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States. Built on the former site of the Hubert H. Humphrey Metrodome, the indoor stadium opened in 2016 and is the home of the Minnesota Vikings (NFL); it also hosts early season college baseball games of the University of Minnesota Golden Gophers (NCAA).
The Vikings played at the Metrodome from 1982 until its closure in 2013; during construction, the Vikings played two seasons (2014, 2015) at the open-air TCF Bank Stadium on the campus of the University of Minnesota.[13] The team's first home was Metropolitan Stadium in Bloomington (1961–1981), now the site of the Mall of America.
On June 17, 2016, U.S. Bank Stadium was deemed substantially complete by contractor Mortenson Construction, six weeks before the ribbon-cutting ceremony and official grand opening on July 22. Authority to use and occupy the stadium was handed over to the Vikings and the Minnesota Sports Facilities Authority. The Vikings played their first pre-season game at U.S. Bank Stadium on August 28; the home opener of the regular season was in week two against the Green Bay Packers on September 18, a 17–14 victory.[14]
It is the first fixed-roof stadium built in the NFL since Ford Field in Detroit, which opened in 2002. As of March 2015, the overall budget was estimated to be $1.061 billion, with $348 million from the state of Minnesota, $150 million from the city of Minneapolis, and $551 million from the team and private contributions.[7]
U.S. Bank Stadium hosted Super Bowl LII won by the Philadelphia Eagles on February 4, 2018,[15] the ESPN X Games on July 19–22, 2018, and the NCAA Final Four won by the Virginia Cavaliers on April 6–8, 2019. The stadium was to host the 2020 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships, but it was cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

description_text:
version 1.02
added Sci Fi Tower added Ocatog prefabsFixed Road prefansFixed Textures
A high-quality asset pack designed for quick sci-fi style city building for HDRP, SRP, and 3D pipelines.
By default the package was designed for URP.
The pack contain several constructors:17 prefabs for road constructor.110 prefabs for building constructor.17 prefabs for palisades constructor.25 prefabs for rooftops constructor.6 prefabs for antennas.4 prefabs for trees.
The road constructor is gridded. The grid size is 38 m. In the future I have a plan to grow this constructor. add tunnelsadd road junctionsand so on.
There are 17 PBR-materials.
The building constructor is not gridded. There are two types of floors. They are different by the height of windows (3.5 m and 5.5 m now). You can see how I use this in the demo scene. I am using a name-convention. The template for building is:sci_fi_building_03_section_1_h3_f1.sci_fi_building_[index of building_profile]section[size_of_section]_h[height of windows]_f[number of floor in section]The size of the sections is sorted.
There are 37 PBR-materials.
I am planning to add more texture-settings for more deep variations. Now the setting name is Basic_sci_fi.Also there are two texture-settings for roads. I am using tileable textures.The all objects share the same atlased textures.
All textures and maps compatible with Unity3d standard-material. All models are sharing only a few textures. The geometry is optimized for frustum culling, batching and ect.All prefabs models and other models are in FBX formats. Models contain about 300 tris and depend on its size in the world. The all metallic-textures is 1024 size and contain:R channel - metalness.
G channel - ambient occlusion.
B channel - empty.
A channel - smoothness.
In the Unity project I switched off texture filtering and reduced texture size in the compression settings. I made it for PlayStation 2 style graphics.Therefore you can use textures as a template to draw your own textures.
Feel free to let me know if you need something moreemail: philatovma@gmail.com

This huge and detailed volcano is an impressive landmark for your landscape visualization projects.
The scenery is suitable both for realtime 3D and CGI. The mesh comes in three different polycounts, so you can freely chose the right model for your project. All texture maps are included in 4k resolutions. 
You also get the original height map in 16bit TIFF and RAW formats to use either in your terrain editing software of choice (i.e. Unity, UE), or as displacement map in any 3D application.   - Low: 7,983 Tris

  - Diffuse, Normal (Y/Y+) and Heightmaps (RAW, TIFF) in 4096x4096 resolution.

  - Included masks: Rock/snow, flow, wear and deposition - can be used for texture placement and many other purposes.

Any questions? Don’t hesitate to contact us!

description_text:
This Desert Environment package features an arid ecosystem of strange plants that flow in the wind; growing in an ancient crater set on a desert planet.The package contains everything you need for your game environment; including 10 unique plant species, 5 rocks , a realistic Landscape, a tileable backdrop landscape mesh, along with a beautiful starry sky.You can download a packaged demo of the Unreal 4 project here:https://bit.ly/APV2_Demo
This package currently supports Unreal 4, but FBX files and textures are also included. I have future plans to bring this to Unity.
The Plant species are the following:

  - Spiky Palm Tree (4 Variations)

  - Fat Bottle Tree

  - Glowing seed-tree

  - Alien Cactus

  - Alien Flower

  - Ring Shrub

  - Green Spiky plant

  - Red Spiky plant

  - Grass clump

  - Glowing Wheat-Grass

The plant's materials have been designed along with a wind system blueprint, which provides you with realistic flowing of grass, shrubs & trees, with minimal performance impact. You can modify the wind simply by changing the public variables on the blueprint, and it will apply to all materials that utilize the wind system.
The unreal landscape and the backdrop landscape mesh have been generated by World Creator, which utilizes splat-map texture masks. To replace the landscapes, you can generate your own within World Creator along with its own splatmaps. Simply swap out the splatmap texture and apply the landscape material, and your landscape will instantly be rendered with the realism seen in the preview images.
This package also includes a beautiful sky environment, complete with flickering stars, two planet textures, and a realistic planet material.
Features:
  - 10 Plant Species (13 Static-meshes)
  -  5 Unique Rocks

  - Wind Controller blueprint that affects plant materials via Material collection Parameter

  - World Creator Terrain with Material that uses Splatmaps (You can create your own using World Creator and apply the material)

  - Tileable distance terrain static mesh for exterior environment

  - Night-time Glow and Hue of meshes and environment controlled by Material Collection Parameter

  - Flickering Star Material

  - Realistic Planet Material

  - 2 original Planet textures

  - Number of Unique Meshes: 21

  - Collision: Yes, automatically generated

  - LODs: 3-4

  - Number of Materials and Material Instances: 48

  - Number of Textures: 72

Vertex Counts (for highest LODs):

  - Trees = 38000 to 13000

  - Smaller Plants = 8000 to 3500

  - Horizon Landscape = 40000

  - Grass = 1400 to 540

Texture Resolutions:

  - 4096 = 2

  - 2048 = 12

  - 1024 = 23

  - 512 = 11

  - 256 = 4

  - 128 = 1

  - 64 (Terrain) = 16

description_text:
Villa Bella - Art gallery

This white-plastered cubic building at the Cote d-Azur, a landmark between palmtrees and rock-formations, has served for many years as an exhibition space for art-galleries of fame.

The Black & White theme of the house can also be found in the details. The black steel ladder functions as a unique piece of decoration en maybe even as a natural harness for the fragile handmade vase. Next to it is the floorlamp Cubik 180, designed by Jean-Mari Massaud (2005).

The long white sofa Andy, a design by Paolo Piva (2002), placed in line with the hanging balcony, accentuates the horizontal interaction of lines, to be found throughout the building.

The side-table is a design by Antonio Cittero (2003) from the Simplice-collection of Maxalto.

The chairs, from the SOLO-series by Antonio Citterio, placed around The Table by designer Monica Armani (2006) form the central meetingpoint in the house.

Specifactions:
Original MAX 2009-file (Mental Ray)
Mental Ray materials (Mostly procedural mappings)
Textures paintings etc. included
Daylight system MR + SkyPortal
Preview images contain Post-Effects; Photoshop (example-file included), AO-pass (max2009-file included (Mental Ray))
Also available as; .obj (exported, incl .mtl) .3ds (exported)

MAX specific; Where possible Modifier-stack intact.

description_text:
Description:Set of Chairs
Are you looking for something that will make your interior scene more interesting and remarkable? Do you keen on perfectionistic scene, but you don’t have enough time to model all by yourself? These models will work perfectly for you!
Basic info
This set consists of ten chairs in different styles, done using Blender and Cycles rendering engine. Models are in real-world scale, close to center, everything is sorted into groups and models are on separate layers. Models, groups and materials are properly named. Scene is ready-to-render. All materials are made of procedural textures.
All materials are procedural, easy to use and look really nice and convincing.
Sorting of models
Models are on separate layersModels are placed close to centerModels are true-to-scaleLogicaly namedScene is ready-to-render
Appending models
Open your own .blendGo to File > AppendGo into models/groupsSelect model/group you want to append
Materials
Materials are procedural and may look very complicated. But don't worry. They are designed to be easy to work with. A pdf describing the materials is provided. Check the link below for node setups of my materials. https://www.flickr.com/photos/135299906@N05/?
Listed numbers of verts. and faces are as I used for my renders (not wireframes)
Chair 1 – 5 252 Verts., 5 248 Faces, 10 496 TrisChair 2 – 6 274 Verts., 6 272 Faces, 12 544 TrisChair 3 – 25 470Verts., 25472 Faces, 50 944 TrisChair 4 – 14 720Verts., 14 720 Faces, 29 440 TrisChair 5 – 5 570 Verts., 5 548 Faces, 11 136 TrisChair 6 – 5 474 Verts., 5 472 Faces, 10 944 TrisChair 7 – 14 912 Verts., 14 914 Faces, 29 828 TrisChair 8 – 17 954 Verts., 17 920 Faces, 35 840 TrisChair 9 – 10 822 Verts., 10 816 Faces, 21 632 TrisChair 10 – 11 808 Verts., 11 800 Faces, 23 600 Tris

description_text:
ATTENTION: this price is ridiculous and may not last for long!
I took about half a year to accomplish this and I didn´t do anything else, works or jobs meanwhile. This is a realistic and complete urban scenery consisting of many, many contemporarybuildings, roads, traffic signals, including a stadium, a bridge, an ocean, an earthly ground and a 360º rotatable background as you can see in the animation below. You also have roads outside the city where you can make rally (this is best seen in the animation).
You can even go to the moon through a tunnel after you pass the bridge. That earth/moon image you see above was made with this model. What more can you ask? All objects are textured.
Unlike some large city models that only allow you to see the city scape from a distant view (fly-through animations...) or other models that can be seen closer but are just a block of a city, this model here is huge and allows you to see from a distance as well as close. It can be used for cinema, tv, games... everything.
YOU WON´T FIND A LOWER PRICE!
I have to say this though: although this model is low-poly, it is so huge and has so many things that you will need a good computer to be able to manage this file.
For that reason I have now divided the model in 3 files. The file cita_main has all the buildings and roads; the file cita_less_buildings is not as important but it has many things like signals and trees, etc; the file bridge and boats has to do with the ocean part. If you wish you can merge some parts of the other files into the main file (cita_main) and they will appear in the same exact place where they were before I divided the model.
You can always cut or hide some portions of this collection if you think you don´t need them all, or you can copy some items to fill in where you think is emptier.
(Note: the file 'cita_main' also works in 3ds max 8)
Note: The cita full zipped file is the entire city ensembled. You will need to place that extracted file inside the CITA\_venda folder, which is the folder where the other 3 splitted files of the city are.
Thank you very much for your preference.
ATTENTION: this price is ridiculous and may not last for long!

description_text:
Greek temples were structures built to house deity statues within Greek sanctuaries in Greek paganism. The temples themselves did usually not directly serve a cult purpose, since the sacrifices and rituals dedicated to the respective deity took place outside them. Temples were frequently used to store votive offerings. They are the most important and most widespread building type in Greek architecture. In the Hellenistic kingdoms of Southwest Asia and of North Africa, buildings erected to fulfill the functions of a temple often continued to follow the local traditions. Even where a Greek influence is visible, such structures are not normally considered as Greek temples. This applies, for example, to the Graeco-Parthian and Bactrian temples, or to the Ptolemaic examples, which follow Egyptian tradition. Most Greek temples were oriented astronomically.

description_text:
- detailed exterior, simple interior.
- every object has material name, you can easily change or apply materials
.
.
.
.max format:
Rar archive contains three scenes
1. 3ds max 2010 with vray materials, which you can see in preview images studio renders. Carpaint colour can be different. 
2. 3ds max 2010 with mental ray materials, which you can see in preview images outdoor renders. Carpaint colour can be different. 
3. 3ds max 2010 with simple standard materials scanline
Just put into your scene and render!
In each scene model is provided with mesh smooth modifier on stack on objects that need it. Mesh smooth is set 1 or 2 for renders. Exterior and wheels are in different layers. 
.
.obj format:
Rar archive contains two versions of model with simple materials:
1. Exported without collapsing after mesh smooth. Low or med poly mesh which you can see in preview images, good if you need to edit model.
2. Exported after appllying mesh smooth. Just import, apply materials and render
.
.lwo, .xsi, .c4d format:
Rar archive contains model exported without collapsing after mesh smooth. Low or med poly mesh which you can see in preview images, good if you need to edit model.
Simple materials.
.
.fbx and .3ds format:
Rar archive contains model exported after appllying mesh smooth. Just import, apply materials and render.

description_text: High resolution, very detailed 3D model of an igloo. Modelled in Blender 2.68 with materials and high resolution ambient texture, for very accurate detail rendering.   - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessary—just drop your models into the scene and start rendering.
